envelope.note: Assume um lado pressionado com primarias completas, o lado oposto na base e um RED ativo adicional.

priceMoveMetrics.note: price_move_ticks = |delta_preco| / priceTickSize; signedPriceMoveTicks > 0 indica movimento bruto a favor da posicao.

quantityMetrics.note: quantity e volume sao expressos diretamente no ativo-base do contrato Crypto.

finalCleanup.note: No synthetic final close is executed. Open positions remain in state and are reported as unrealized mark-to-market.

liquidationRiskByMargin.note: totalNet already includes liquidation losses; lossUsd is the isolated liquidation-loss component.

marginConsistency.note: funding and spot-loan interest are accounted as separate Crypto cost components.
